knownCaveats: DBT segment create used includeDbt.models.models[] successfully
Data stream formula fields use the Data 360 formula library, not Query SQL
The public Data 360 model gallery is a normalized subject-area map for anchor DMO, grain, and relationship-path design
Query, transform, segment, analytics, activation, and orchestration surfaces can use different validation paths
Data 360 API / Direct API uses tenant-specific token exchange and endpoint handling, unlike Connect REST API and Apex ConnectApi
Data kits are the central deploy/package abstraction for Data 360 metadata; raw data is not packaged
External data architecture should choose ingestion, live query, accelerated query, file federation, or hybrid before implementation
DBT segment readback can normalize to includeDbt.models[]
Approximate segment count can fail when the feature is disabled
Segment member retrieval depends on a delta window
External activation destinations and search-index creation need enabled assets before cookbook promotion
publicBoundary: No raw Salesforce Help exports, generated caches, lab data, credentials, or org-specific metadata are published.
